# Adopt Rust example

Rust workspace with three path crates (`api`, `support`, `worker`) and a manifest-free `solo` directory.

```sh
bazel run @rules_dx//dx/launch:dx -- init //rust/tests/fixtures/adopt_rust/...
bazel run @rules_dx//dx/launch:dx -- generate //rust/tests/fixtures/adopt_rust/...
bazel build //rust/tests/fixtures/adopt_rust/...
bazel test //rust/tests/fixtures/adopt_rust/...
```

All 5 tests pass (`api_test`, `api_roundtrip_test`, `common_test`, `helper_test`, `solo_test`).
